shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- agent files ---'; find . -name AGENTS.md -print"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- app files ---'; for f in app/*.tsx next.config.ts; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done; printf '"'%s\\n' '--- relevant docs ---'; rg -l -i \"partial prerender|cache components|use cache|suspense\" node_modules/next/dist/docs | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "for f in \\
 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md \\
 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/ppr-platform-guide.md \\
 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md \\
 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md \\
 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md \\
 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md \\
 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md; do
  echo \"### "'$f"
  rg -n -C 4 "Partial Prerender|Suspense|use cache|cacheLife|loading|shell|runtime data|uncached" "$f" | sed -n '"'1,240p'
done"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md; printf '\\n--- use cache ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md; printf '\\n--- cache life ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md; printf '\\n--- fetching ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- build artifacts ---'; find .next/server/app -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- prerendered shell markers ---'; rg -n \"Dashboard|Loading dashboard|Total Revenue|Revenue\" .next/server/app .next/static 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,100p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- tsconfig diff ---'; git diff -- tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
@@
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
printf '%s\\n' '--- final status ---'; git status --short
printf '%s\\n' '--- focused diff check ---'; git diff --check -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx
printf '%s\\n' '--- changed files ---'; git diff --stat -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx; wc -l app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx
printf '%s\\n' '--- numbered sources ---'; nl -ba app/page.tsx; nl -ba app/loading.tsx; nl -ba app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx
@@
 export function DashboardSkeleton() {
   return (
-    <div aria-busy=\"true\" aria-label=\"Loading dashboard\">
+    <div role=\"status\" aria-busy=\"true\" aria-label=\"Loading dashboard\">
*** End Patch
PATCH
git diff --check -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx"
